title: Erin's Challenge! Episode 2 — 学校生活 (School Life)
description: From NHK's Erin's Challenge! (エリンが挑戦！にほんごできます。). Episode 2 follows Erin navigating a day at a Japanese high school: class schedules, club activities (部活動), talking to classmates and teachers, the school lunch system (給食), and after-school routines. Natural student-to-student and student-to-teacher dialogue with clear enunciation. Companion to Episode 1 (introductions).
creator: NHK (日本放送協会)
